mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it triggers anticipation of aggressive policy support that drives positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST show consecutive 2-month increases.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising during early recovery.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 1.0% indicates deflationary risks that prompt central banks to maintain ultra-low rates, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: During recessions, rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates consumer resilience, signaling economic stabilization and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing activity and economic growth, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO shows consecutive 1-month increases.
